finds.title: Vintage  Composition  Doll,19"
finds.note: 19" 1930s–40s composition girl, mohair wig, sleep eyes, original outfit + trunk. Unmarked $50–90; marked Effanbee/Madame Alexander/Arranbee with wardrobe could reach ~$195. ASK: mark on back of neck/shoulders.

finds.title: 9 Antique Straight Razors
finds.note: Terapeak: Heartring singles $25–45 (n=5); razor lots sell cheap ($10–20 per 3–6). Sold singly 9 × ~$27 ≈ $240 gross → ~$120 profit at $75 → Tier B. ASK: blade photos both sides, edges.

finds.title: vintage ice bucket/wine chiller
finds.note: Heavy clear glass ice bucket, Lens matched Tiffany & Co. If acid-etched TIFFANY & CO. on base: ~$100–150 → profit ~$50. Unmarked $15–30. ASK: base photo.

finds.title: Vintage Barbie doll case
finds.note: 1965 Mattel Barbie/Francie/Skipper trunk (SPP) + 2nd case. Empty $25–45; with 1960s dolls/mod clothes $100–700 (lots sold $702–911). ASK: open both cases, photos of contents.

finds.title: Vintage Spear Fishing Decoys
finds.note: 14 handmade fish spearing decoys, $20 ea / $225 lot. Sold handmade decoys median $35-45 ea. At $225 lot profit ~$200 (< $225 needed). Offer $150 for all 14 -> profit ~$275. Tier C (offer)

finds.title: Vintage 1960’s Bossons Heads
finds.note: 24 Bossons (Congleton, England) chalkware heads, 1960s; body: $5 each or $100 the set, some small chips. Terapeak singles median $16–22, mixed lots $67–140. Sold singly (buyer pays ship) ~$360–480 gross → ~$200+ profit at $100 but 24 listings; as 3–4 themed sets less. ASK: back stamps, which have chips; offer ~$75 for all.

finds.title: Vintage Hummel Figurines
finds.note: Terapeak: TMK-2 full-bee singles median $25 (p25 $17, p75 $45, n=49). 20 × ~$25–30 → ~$500–600 gross sold singly; at $200 profit ≈ $200–250 after fees/inbound ship (buyers pay outbound) → Tier B, labor 20 listings, fragile. Offer $200 (cap). ASK: base marks + model numbers (larger/rarer models like Chimney Sweep 12, Angel Serenade push it up).

finds.title: Vintage PUMA Pocket knife
finds.note: Puma 230365 lockback w/ box, $50. One NOS comp $173; Puma boxed lockbacks median $150. Profit $38-65 -> borderline Tier C; ask if unused

finds.title: Vintage Hoppalong Cassidy watch
finds.note: 1950 US Time Hopalong Cassidy watch, untested, $25 porch pickup. Running loose $50–100; with saddle box $200+. ASK: does it run when wound; box?

finds.title: Fender guitar/bass strap. Vintage
finds.note: 1970s Fender monogram strap (brown/gold woven, Fender script logos, leather ends, brass slider). Fraying at the lower end. At $15, vintage 70s monogram straps resell ~$60-100. Ask for photos of the other leather end and the back, and the full length. Buy if both ends are intact. Offer $15 shipped or less.

finds.title: Vintage tryolean purse
finds.note: Photo: 1950s box purse - tortoise Lucite lid and arch handle on a pierced chrome-filigree metal body. Lucite-lid metal box bags sell ~$60-150; Rialto/Wilardy/Patricia of Miami marked up to $200+. At $40 profit only clears $50 if resale >= ~$130. Ask: photo of inside lid/frame for a maker stamp (Rialto, Wilardy, Charles S. Kahn, Dorset Rex), cracks at hinges, interior lining; offer $25 shipped-ready.

finds.title: Antique Brass Bowl. 19th Century Persian
finds.note: Tier B (thin comps): cast/engraved Persian-Islamic bronze bowl w/ calligraphy band, 4.5in, $49 SF. Sold Islamic calligraphy bronze bowls $120-250 (n=3). Profit ~$80. Risk: modern Afghan repro - ask for base photo / patina inside foot

finds.title: Limoges T&V Art Deco Vase
finds.note: T&V Limoges 8" trumpet vase, stylized iris + gold, c.1905–15. Only T&V blank (amateur): $60–120 pass. Pickard/Stouffer studio mark: $250–450. ASK: sharp base photo.

finds.title: Vintage Green Cameo Uranium Depression Glass Vase
finds.note: Green Hocking Cameo (Ballerina) footed vase ~6" — sold $85–220, median ~$100. Works only at ~$25–35 and no chips. ASK: height, chips, offer $30.

finds.title: Vintage 1970's Choker Necklaces
finds.note: ~12 1970s chains incl. snake/box chains possibly 925. 50 g sterling lot sold $131.70 (Sep 2026). ASK: clasp stamps (925/14K/GF), weight.

finds.title: Vintage Jostens women's Quartz Swiss Gold Tone Watch w/ Hadley band.
finds.note: GE-logo Jostens 21-jewel service-award watch titled quartz, $20 cash, Georgetown IN. Ask for case-back photos (14K vs 10K GF) and whether it runs. 14K → Tier A.

finds.title: Knives
finds.note: "Antique knife Marbles $55" in a Puma lot listing — ask for photo of blade etch/tang stamp (Marble's Gladstone MI) and length; Marble's Ideal pitted ~$80–150

finds.title: Vintage Whitman's Chocolates two sided store sign
finds.note: Whitman's Chocolates painted wood double-sided hanging store sign, 34x8x5/8 in, messenger-boy logo + (R) mark; clean graphics could be 1970s-90s promo or repro. Ask: photos of back/edges/hanger holes for age wear and any maker/printer mark, and whether seller will ship or meet. At $20 only works if genuine pre-1960 (~$120-175 resale; profit ~$50-75 after ~$40 two-way ship of a 34in flat box).

finds.title: Vintage Film Cameras and Accessories
finds.note: Tier A: Nikon F2 Photomic (black) median $228 + Polaroid SX-70 Sonar median $125 + Falcon Special, Brownies, Spartus, Candela meter, projector; est resale ~$550; ~$375 profit. Local pickup (Mesquite, DFW). Ask which lenses are included.

finds.title: Antique Wooden Statue
finds.note: Tier A: 25.25in carved polychrome gilt santo (Nino Jesus), title "Antique Wooden Statue". Carved santos >=$150 sold $200-1,450 (median ~$275-365). ~$215 profit after ~$50 shipping.

finds.title: Antique Brass Andirons
finds.note: Tier B: Pair Louis XV rococo gilt-bronze chenets w/ log bars, listed as brass andirons. Chased pairs sold $797-1,195; plain brass pairs $250-300. ~$180 profit if gilt bronze; ask height + back casting.

finds.title: Hoyt Ultratec with XT3000 (2 sets) and accesories
finds.note: Tier A: Hoyt UltraTec + spare XT3000 limbs, sights, case; needs strings (~$30). UltraTec median $200 + limbs $60-120. ~$140 profit. Ask to ship (~$35).

finds.title: Original full-size Furbys
finds.note: Tier B: Eight 1998 Tiger Furbys 70-800 new in box, $10 each. NIB median $50 each -> ~$400; ~$130 profit after shipping. Ask box-front photos.

finds.title: Huge Cymbal Bundle – Zildjian / Paiste / Sabian – Below Market Price!
finds.note: Tier C: Zildjian 23in A Sweet Ride (median $380) + 7 more cymbals. Only works if $123 is the whole bundle AND they ship from Maui (~$100). ~$290 profit if so.

finds.title: Vintage Music Box
finds.note: Tier C: Thorens AD30 + 23 discs listed as "Vintage Music Box". Box median $130 + discs ~$150. Clears at a $75 offer (~$100 profit).
